prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: existing Perllan family coat of arms for a website. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Primary request: remove ONLY the white background OUTSIDE the outermost circular gold border and make that outside area truly transparent (alpha 0). Preserve the exact existing circular emblem without redrawing or restyling: exact gold tree and roots, gold leaves and small flowers, all red berries, dark forest-green solid interior, Celtic gold circular knot border, gold texture and all existing edges. Every pixel INSIDE the circle must remain fully opaque. Keep the same centered square composition and proportions and a clean antialiased circular boundary. The white square corners become transparent. No white halo, no glow, no shadow, no replacement background, no checkerboard painted into the image. Do not simplify any motif, do not remove the green interior, do not change the branches, berries, flowers or knotwork. Output a transparent PNG.
